title: Irrationality of cubic threefolds after one stabilization
description: This manuscript proves unconditionally that X times P1 is irrational for every smooth complex cubic threefold X. The proof uses the ordinary, non-enhanced Hodge-atom package as a birational ledger and introduces a rank-two atomic residue discriminant: the double zero packet of the cubic small quantum connection defines a single Hodge atom, a canonical elementary modification of its even rank-two block has residue discriminant 4/9, and curve and surface representatives are excluded, so the projective-bundle atom formula obstructs rationality. The explicit cubic framed-monodromy computation nu_6(X) = 2, the stabilization identity nu_6(X times P1) = 4, the integral cycle-theoretic results, and irrationality of V times P1 for every smooth prime Fano threefold V of genus eight are unconditional as well. A finer framed-monodromy refinement is conditional on Hypotheses 5.7R and 5.7T, reconstruction-tail invariance and the divisor-tagging specialization step; under them the primitive-sixth framed-monodromy multiplicity is birationally invariant through dimension four, which gives a second proof of the irrationality theorem. The cycle argument proves all-degree integral saturation for marked finite-etale graph quotients of elliptic powers and constructs a non-isotrivial A5-invariant family whose members are universally CH0-trivial, so universal CH0-triviality and rationality after one stabilization separate unconditionally on the same stabilized varieties.
